comparator.name: Animal Sciences
comparator.academicYear: Current 2026–2027 programme and published cohort-2025 course scheme, checked 2026-09-28
comparator.sourceNotes: The official English-taught three-year bachelor totals 180 EC. The published programme page and cohort course scheme show 60 EC in each year, a shared animal-biology foundation, a second-year choice between Animal Management and Care and Biological Functioning of Animals, and third-year specialisation, free choice and thesis research. Animal Management and Care is selected by the official-order tie-break. Where the public scheme does not expose individual EC values, the components preserve the official year totals and published subject groupings rather than inventing optional course selections.

notes.text: WUR Animal Sciences contains dedicated animal nutrition, breeding, production, epidemiology, internship, specialisation and animal-specific thesis work. UCR can build biologically rigorous animal-focused and sustainability pathways, but it does not reproduce a professional Animal Sciences curriculum or its dedicated husbandry sequence. The alternatives are defensible liberal-arts pathways, not structural equivalence.
